geometries.method: Editorial point along the 2004 surveyed inner southeast Greenland shelf; not a surveyed jet core or path endpoint. Distinct from the shelfbreak East Greenland Current.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: A summer 2004 hydrographic and velocity survey identified this inner-shelf branch along the approximately 1,000 km southeast Greenland shelf south of Denmark Strait. That is a documented regional reach, not a measured whole-current path or a year-round length; the offshore East Greenland Current is distinct.
